import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 1000005;
    static final int mod1 = 998244353;
    static final int mod2 = 1000000007;
    static final int base = 1000000;

    static long n;
    static List<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[10];
    static long gg;
    static int[] sum = new int[10];
    static int ans;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void readLong(BufferedReader br, StringTokenizer st, LongHolder holder) throws IOException {
        while (!st.hasMoreTokens()) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        }
        holder.value = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
    }

    static class LongHolder {
        long value;
    }

    static void dfs1(int u, long x) {
        gg++;
        int val = (int) ((gg - x + mod1) % mod1);
        v[u].add(val);
        sum[u] = (sum[u] + (val % mod2)) % mod2;
        if (u == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs1(u + 1, 10 * x + i);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(long x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if (x * base + base - 1 <= n && x * base * 10 > n) {
            long rk = gg;
            for (int i = 0, bit = 1; i <= 6; i++, bit *= 10) {
                int mae = (int) (((rk - x * bit) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1);
                int pos = lowerBound(v[i], -mae + mod1);
                long temp = ((1L * mae * v[i].size() % mod2 + sum[i]) % mod2 - 1L * (v[i].size() - pos) * mod1 % mod2 + mod2) % mod2;
                ans = (int) ((ans + temp) % mod2);
                gg += v[i].size();
            }
            return;
        }
        ans = (int) ((ans + ((++gg - x) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1) % mod2);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        LongHolder holder = new LongHolder();
        readLong(br, st, holder);
        n = holder.value;

        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(v[i]);
        }
        gg = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(i);
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
